limitations: Conditional design only: 80 separately predeclared coverage claims, Bonferroni family-wise one-sided confidence, zero misses per claim, independent representative Bernoulli physical holdout groups within each claim, fixed protocol and genuine blinded evaluation. Bonferroni does not require independence across techniques; the same verified physical groups may be reused across techniques when every claim is valid on them. These are necessary numerical zero-miss bounds for the stated protocol, not observed performance, a sufficient G2 sample size, power analysis, or evidence of independent exposures. Calendar days are not inherently independent groups. No multiple-claim correction is necessary when only one claim is prespecified; do not assert 80 simultaneous claims unless all are preregistered and scientifically meaningful.
